snippet.title: PAYDAY 3: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
It is with great excitement that we present this first look at the gameplay of PAYDAY 3.
This gameplay trailer takes place at a branch location of Secure Capital Bank somewhere in the bowels of New York City. We follow Dallas, Chains, Wolf and Hoxton as they don their masks and show the world that nowhere is safe enough from the Payday Gang.

Pre-order PAYDAY 3 here: https://www.paydaythegame.com/payday3/
You can find a lot of relevant links to social media and others here: https://pd3.link/tree
